title.narrative: Supporting Pacific Genetic Diversity for Climate Resilient Agriculture

description.narrative: This investment supports the implementation of the business plan (second phase) of the Centre for Pacific Crops and Trees (CePaCT) over the period 2024-2028. CePaCT, as the Pacific’s only regional genebank and established by the Pacific Community (SPC), plays a crucial role in leveraging the unique biodiversity of the Pacific to enhance food and nutrition security and build resilience against the increasing variability of climate change for SPC members. This investment supports CePaCT meet international genebank standards and excellence; strengthen germplasm security and diversity for climate adaptation and enhanced climate resilience; and facilitate access, collaboration, and target community impact and resilience to the impacts of climate change.

participating-org.narrative: AUSTRALIA - Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
SECRETARIAT OF THE PACIFIC COMMUNITY (SPC NEW CALEDONIA)

organisation.narrative: Australia - Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade

description.narrative: This investment supports the Pacific Community's regional genebank, the Centre for Pacific Crops and Trees (CePaCT). CePaCT operates under the Land Resources Division of the Pacific Community (SPC). 2024 marked the commencement of the second phase of CePaCT under its 10 year investment plan. Australian support provided core funding for the activities of CePaCT including operational systems, conservation of collections, germplasm access and use and regional coordination and outreach. Supporting CePaCT helps with the long-term conservation and distribution of key crops and trees of the Pacific, critical for adapting to the pressures of climate change and contributing to the long-term food security for the region.
